data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'halh' meaning 'hollow' or 'safe place' and 'roc' meaning 'rock'. Hallock can mean 'hollow rock' or 'rocky hill'. This name may have been given to a child born near a rocky hill or to one whose family lived in such a place. The name Hallock carries the meaning “Rock or hollow hill” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Hallock usually hope their child will grow to embody rock or hollow hill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
